I would recommend the HomeLight team for anyone who desires a stress free transaction</p><a alt="See review on Google" class="link" href="https://goo.gl/maps/3BTakiUopMrAs3wSA" rel="noopener" target="_blank">See review on Google</a></div></div></li><li class="review text-left"><div class="row"><div class="col-xs-1 col-sm-2"><div class="quote">“</div></div><div class="col-xs-7"><span class="name">William Smith</span><span class="relation">Sold with a HomeLight agent</span></div><div class="col-xs-4 col-sm-3"><div class="date">a month ago</div></div></div><div class="row"><div class="col-xs-1 col-sm-2"></div><div class="col-xs-11 col-sm-9"><p class="desc">I highly recommend HomeLight when looking for a realtor. Once we completed the improvements to our house as suggested, our realtor was able to get the house on the market right away. Within 2 days, we received a full price offer on our home. And, I just received my commission rebate from HomeLight in the mail yesterday. Thanks HomeLight for making the process of selling our home so much easier!</p><a alt="See review on Google" class="link" href="https://goo.gl/maps/uPpbkyREBPdP4PU16" rel="noopener" target="_blank">See review on Google</a></div></div></li><li class="review text-left"><div class="row"><div class="col-xs-1 col-sm-2"><div class="quote">“</div></div><div class="col-xs-7"><span class="name">Buddy Villatoro</span><span class="relation">Sold with a HomeLight agent</span></div><div class="col-xs-4 col-sm-3"><div class="date">4 weeks ago</div></div></div><div class="row"><div class="col-xs-1 col-sm-2"></div><div class="col-xs-11 col-sm-9"><p class="desc">As first-time home sellers, we were overwhelmed with advice and recommendations from friends, ads in the mail, unreliable, confusing, contradictory results from online search engines. The well-known real estate sites seemed to complicate the process even more. Turning to HomeLight was just what we needed. Our HomeLight representative was a great help at the start our process. No other site or resource offered that type of attention and service. The search for agents provided two names who knew our neighborhood and our town, and the top choice had just sold a home on our street a few days before. The reviews were clear and objective; the information, reliable; and the results, well presented. We contacted the two agents. Both responded quickly, and both scheduled meetings in two days. We ultimately hired the top choice. And we had a bid on our house in twenty-one days, and the buyers’ appraiser settled on the exact agreed selling price—just as our agent predicted. I highly recommend HomeLight. In just minutes, it helped us find the type of agent we wanted and needed.</p><a alt="See review on Google" class="link" href="https://goo.gl/maps/qVtLMngyEQ7gxgiQ8" rel="noopener" target="_blank">See review on Google</a></div></div></li><li class="review text-left"><div class="row"><div class="col-xs-1 col-sm-2"><div class="quote">“</div></div><div class="col-xs-7"><span class="name">MK Siemionko</span><span class="relation">Sold with a HomeLight agent</span></div><div class="col-xs-4 col-sm-3"><div class="date">a month ago</div></div></div><div class="row"><div class="col-xs-1 col-sm-2"></div><div class="col-xs-11 col-sm-9"><p class="desc">HomeLight made finding the perfect real estate agent a breeze. Through that realtor I was also able to secure a team of additional professionals to assist me with the sale of my home in New York. By essentially prescreening real estate professionals for me, HomeLight took away any issues that may have arisen via "guesswork" in trying to find the perfect real estate agent, which was incredibly important as I was out of state after listing and required a tried and true expert to help me with the process remotely.
